Docs.title: Documentation & Quickstart
Docs.description: Comprehensive engineering guide for next-starter: modular architecture, Auth.js v5, getdesign.md tokens, and production deployment.
Docs.quickstartDesc: Scaffold a production Next.js 16 application with React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI, and your choice of 20+ design systems with a single command.
Docs.cliOptionsDesc: The create-starter-next CLI provides full control over presets, package managers, and design system token injection.
Docs.designSystemsDesc: Every archetype includes calibrated OKLCH CSS variables, button radius tokens, and mesh gradients injected directly into globals.css and DESIGN.md.
Docs.folderStructureDesc: Code is organized into isolated domain modules under src/modules/<feature>, keeping routes thin and components reusable.
Docs.authDesc: Auth.js (NextAuth v5) server configuration lives in src/core/auth/ with support for OAuth, Credentials, and session verification.
Docs.networkSuiteDesc: Production-ready HTTP client (apiClient), Server-Sent Events (useSSE), and WebSockets (useSocket) with retry logic and parser error boundaries.
Docs.i18nDesc: Fully localized routes with locale switching, subpath prefixes (/en, /es, /fr, /de, /ja), and localized metadata.
